name: Citrix Workspace LTSR
exists_query: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name GLOB 'Citrix Workspace [0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]*' AND publisher = 'Citrix Systems, Inc.' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM registry WHERE key IN ('HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Citrix\ICA Client\AutoUpdate\Commandline Policy', 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Citrix\ICA Client\AutoUpdate\Commandline Policy') AND name = 'LTSROnly' AND data = 'true');
